qualification_basis.description: Synthetic example: a compact inline gas-liquid separation system replacing a conventional vessel in a new application.
qualification_basis.intended_use: Primary separation of a wet gas stream with a lower footprint and weight than a conventional separator.
qualification_basis.environment: Operating pressure, temperature and fluid composition taken from the project design basis (public example values).
functions: Separate liquid from gas to the downstream specification
Handle turndown and slugging without loss of separation
Allow safe shutdown, depressurisation and inspection
performance_expectations: Liquid carry-over below the specified limit over the full flow range
Design life 25 years with the planned maintenance interval
regulatory_requirements: Applicable pressure-equipment and safety regulations (to be confirmed)

elements.name: Pressure-containing body
evidence: Third-party type approval for another application (synthetic)

elements.name: Internal separation device
elements.function: Separate phases at high gas load

elements.name: Level and control software
elements.function: Control level and detect abnormal operation
evidence: Existing control platform in company use (synthetic)

benefits.text: Lower weight and footprint enable the concept.
Shorter delivery time than a large conventional vessel.

risks.text: Qualification of the internal device may sit on the project critical path.
risks.mitigation: Start qualification early; keep a conventional fallback in the concept study.

risks.text: Performance not reproduced at full scale.

standardisation: Standard unit sizes could be reused across projects.
multi_implementation: The same internal device could serve several fields.
